NAME: SPI slave verification plan
details: Block 14: garuda_spis_top with garuda_spis_core and the APB shim. In-house. The link to the ESP32 companion. Source: GARUDA-SPIS-SPEC-001, decisions D-14, D-16, D-17, D-21. Feature-level plan written 2026-10-04, before the UVM environment. Sign-off criteria: flow/0_signoff_criteria.md.

NAME: A Registers
details: APB window 0, 0x4000_0000. Spec section 6.

NAME: F01 RXDATA returns a received byte and removes it
details: Offset 0x00, read-only. Bits 7:0, bits 31:8 read 0. The read drops the DMA request for that byte. Spec [N-6.1].
implementation_note: Method: sim (APB agent, SPI master agent, scoreboard). Today: tb_spis receive checks

NAME: sb_rx
details: Every byte read equals the next byte the SPI master agent sent, in order.
implementation_note: UVM scoreboard against the reference model (written from the spec). Planned.

NAME: F02 TXDATA is the byte sent on the next transfer
details: Offset 0x04, read-write. Loaded into the shifter at the start of each byte; if not rewritten the same value is sent again. Requirement R-2, spec [N-6.2].
implementation_note: Method: sim. Today: tb_spis; defect SPIS-4 found here

NAME: sb_tx
details: Every byte the SPI master agent receives equals TXDATA at the start of that byte.
implementation_note: UVM scoreboard against the reference model (written from the spec). Planned.

NAME: cg_spis_tx.cp_update
details: TXDATA rewritten between every byte, not rewritten, and rewritten in the middle of a byte.
implementation_note: Covergroup in the UVM environment. Planned.

NAME: F03 CTRL holds EN and the self-clearing RXFLUSH
details: Offset 0x08. Bit 0 EN, bit 1 RXFLUSH empties the receive FIFO and reads 0.
implementation_note: Method: sim (register model). Today: tb_spis

NAME: ral_access CTRL
details: EN read-back; RXFLUSH always reads 0; other bits read 0.
implementation_note: UVM register model test. Planned.

NAME: F04 STATUS reports the receive state
details: Offset 0x0C, read-only. Bit 0 RXVALID, 1 chip select active, 2 OVERRUN sticky, 3 packet done sticky, bits 8:4 FIFO level. The sticky bits are cleared with their IRQSTAT bits and never disagree with them. Defect SPIS-6.
implementation_note: Method: sim + formal. Today: tb_spis

NAME: sb_status
details: Every STATUS read compared with the model.
implementation_note: UVM scoreboard against the reference model (written from the spec). Planned.

NAME: a_status_irqstat_agree
details: STATUS bit 2 equals IRQSTAT bit 2 and STATUS bit 3 equals IRQSTAT bit 1 in every cycle.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/spi_slave/garuda_spis_sva.sv, bound to the block. Planned. Also a formal property - waiting for JasperGold.

NAME: F05 IRQSTAT IRQEN DMACTL and ID in the shim
details: Offsets 0xFE0 to 0xFEC. IRQSTAT bit 0 byte received, 1 packet complete, 2 overrun. DMACTL bit 0 requests while a byte waits. ID reads 0x6A5D, block 14 and the revision.
implementation_note: Method: sim (register model). Today: tb_spis reads ID

NAME: ral_access shim
details: Access policy of the four shim registers.
implementation_note: UVM register model test. Planned.

NAME: F06 Unmapped offsets raise PSLVERR and accesses never wait
details: 0x10 to 0xFDC, 0xFF0 and above, unaligned offsets. PREADY is high in every cycle. Requirement R-5. Defect SPIS-7 was four offsets here answering without an error.
implementation_note: Method: sim + formal. Today: tb_spis PSLVERR at 0x10 to 0x1C; the APB protocol checker is bound - 0 violations

NAME: sb_pslverr
details: PSLVERR compared with the model's address map.
implementation_note: UVM scoreboard against the reference model (written from the spec). Planned.

NAME: a_pready
details: pready_o is 1 in every cycle.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/spi_slave/garuda_spis_sva.sv, bound to the block. Planned. Also a formal property - waiting for JasperGold.

NAME: cg_spis_apb.x_unmapped_rw
details: Each unmapped range read and written.
implementation_note: Covergroup in the UVM environment. Planned.

NAME: F07 Reset values
details: All registers 0, MISO released, no packet in progress. Requirement R-9.
implementation_note: Method: sim (register model). Today: tb_spis

NAME: ral_reset
details: Register model reset test.
implementation_note: UVM register model test. Planned.

NAME: B Bytes on the wire
details: Spec 7.1, 7.2. Checked by an SPI master agent on the pins.

NAME: F08 Receive - most significant bit first mode 0
details: MOSI is taken on each rising edge of SCLK seen through the synchroniser. Requirement R-1, spec [N-7.2].
implementation_note: Method: sim. Today: tb_spis

NAME: sb_rx
details: Model compare.
implementation_note: UVM scoreboard against the reference model (written from the spec). Planned.

NAME: cg_spis_data.cp_byte
details: Bytes 0x00, 0xFF, walking one and walking zero, random.
implementation_note: Covergroup in the UVM environment. Planned.

NAME: F09 Transmit - every byte of a packet
details: MISO changes after the falling edge; every byte of a multi-byte packet is the TXDATA value, not a shifted copy. Requirement R-2. Defect SPIS-4.
implementation_note: Method: sim. Today: tb_spis multi-byte response

NAME: sb_tx
details: Model compare on every byte of packets of 1, 2 and many bytes.
implementation_note: UVM scoreboard against the reference model (written from the spec). Planned.

NAME: a_miso_stable
details: MISO does not change between a falling edge plus its delay and the next falling edge.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/spi_slave/garuda_spis_sva.sv, bound to the block. Planned.

NAME: F10 SCLK up to pclk divided by 6
details: The inputs are oversampled, so the half period must be at least three pclk. 20 MHz at 125 MHz. Requirement R-4, spec [N-7.1a].
implementation_note: Method: sim. Today: tb_spis rate check

NAME: cg_spis_rate.cp_halfperiod
details: SCLK half period of 3, 4, 6 and 60 pclk; unequal high and low times; a half period of 2, which is out of specification, to see that the block does not hang.
implementation_note: Covergroup in the UVM environment. Planned.

NAME: sb_rx
details: Model compare at each rate.
implementation_note: UVM scoreboard against the reference model (written from the spec). Planned.

NAME: F11 Clock edges at any phase to pclk
details: The companion's clock is unrelated to pclk. Every alignment of SCLK, MOSI and chip select edges to pclk must give the same bytes.
implementation_note: Method: sim (randomised phase). Today: no check.

NAME: cg_spis_rate.cp_phase
details: SCLK edge placed in each tenth of the pclk period.
implementation_note: Covergroup in the UVM environment. Planned.

NAME: C Packets
details: Spec 7.3. Requirement R-3.

NAME: F12 A chip select falling edge starts a packet byte aligned
details: The bit counter and shifter reset whatever came before. Spec [N-7.3].
implementation_note: Method: sim + formal. Today: tb_spis

NAME: a_packet_start_aligned
details: The bit counter is 0 in the cycle after a chip select falling edge is seen.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/spi_slave/garuda_spis_sva.sv, bound to the block. Planned. Also a formal property - waiting for JasperGold.

NAME: F13 A chip select rising edge ends the packet
details: IRQSTAT bit 1 and STATUS bit 3 set. Spec [N-7.3].
implementation_note: Method: sim. Today: tb_spis

NAME: sb_status
details: Model compare.
implementation_note: UVM scoreboard against the reference model (written from the spec). Planned.

NAME: cg_spis_pkt.cp_len
details: Packets of 0, 1, 2, 16, 17 and 64 bytes; two packets with the shortest legal gap.
implementation_note: Covergroup in the UVM environment. Planned.

NAME: F14 A partial byte is discarded
details: A packet whose bit count is not a multiple of 8 never puts the part byte in the FIFO. Requirement R-9, spec [N-7.3a].
implementation_note: Method: sim + formal. Today: tb_spis

NAME: a_no_partial_push
details: A byte is pushed only after eight rising edges since the packet start or the previous push.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/spi_slave/garuda_spis_sva.sv, bound to the block. Planned. Also a formal property - waiting for JasperGold.

NAME: cg_spis_pkt.cp_extra_bits
details: Packets ending 1 to 7 bits into a byte.
implementation_note: Covergroup in the UVM environment. Planned.

NAME: F15 EN set while the master is already inside a packet
details: Nothing is received until the next chip select falling edge. Defect SPIS-5.
implementation_note: Method: sim. Today: tb_spis

NAME: cg_spis_pkt.cp_en_phase
details: EN set before a packet, in each bit of a byte, and between bytes; EN cleared mid packet.
implementation_note: Covergroup in the UVM environment. Planned.

NAME: sb_rx
details: Model compare.
implementation_note: UVM scoreboard against the reference model (written from the spec). Planned.

NAME: F16 Clock edges with chip select high are ignored
details: Another device on the same bus must not push bytes here.
implementation_note: Method: sim + formal. Today: no check.

NAME: a_no_push_unselected
details: No byte is pushed while the synchronised chip select is high.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/spi_slave/garuda_spis_sva.sv, bound to the block. Planned. Also a formal property - waiting for JasperGold.

NAME: F17 A glitch on chip select
details: A pulse shorter than the synchroniser can see must not start or end a packet. Not stated in the specification; to be decided and written down.
implementation_note: Method: sim. Today: no check.

NAME: cg_spis_pkt.cp_cs_glitch
details: High and low pulses of less than one pclk on chip select, idle and mid packet.
implementation_note: Covergroup in the UVM environment. Planned.

NAME: D FIFO and overrun
details: Spec 7.5, section 8.

NAME: F18 Receive FIFO level and RXVALID
details: STATUS bits 8:4 count the bytes held; RXVALID is set when the count is not 0.
implementation_note: Method: sim. Today: tb_spis

NAME: sb_fifo
details: Model compare of the level at every read.
implementation_note: UVM scoreboard against the reference model (written from the spec). Planned.

NAME: cg_spis_fifo.cp_level
details: Empty, 1, one below full, full.
implementation_note: Covergroup in the UVM environment. Planned.

NAME: F19 Overrun drops the newest byte and is reported
details: The bytes already held stay contiguous; STATUS bit 2 and IRQSTAT bit 2 set. Requirement R-8, spec [N-7.5].
implementation_note: Method: sim. Today: tb_spis

NAME: sb_fifo
details: Model compare across an overrun of 1 and of several bytes.
implementation_note: UVM scoreboard against the reference model (written from the spec). Planned.

NAME: F20 RXFLUSH
details: Empties the FIFO at once; a byte arriving in the same cycle is not left half pushed.
implementation_note: Method: sim. Today: tb_spis

NAME: cg_spis_fifo.cp_flush_when
details: Flush when empty, full, and in the cycle a byte completes.
implementation_note: Covergroup in the UVM environment. Planned.

NAME: E The MISO pin
details: Spec section 9, requirement R-9.

NAME: F21 MISO is driven only while selected
details: Output enable is 0 out of reset, while chip select is high and while EN is clear, so the line can be shared. Spec [N-9.2].
implementation_note: Method: sim + formal. Today: tb_spis

NAME: a_miso_released
details: spis_miso_oe_o is 0 whenever preset_n is low, EN is 0 or the synchronised chip select is high.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/spi_slave/garuda_spis_sva.sv, bound to the block. Planned. Also a formal property - waiting for JasperGold.

NAME: F Interrupt and DMA
details: Spec 7.4, 7.6. Requirements R-6, R-7.

NAME: F22 Three events are captured and held
details: Byte received, packet complete, overrun. irq_o is the OR of IRQSTAT and IRQEN, held until written 1 to clear. An event in the cycle of the clear is not lost. Defect SPIS-6.
implementation_note: Method: sim + formal. Today: tb_spis

NAME: a_irq_held
details: irq_o equals the OR of IRQSTAT and IRQEN in every cycle.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/spi_slave/garuda_spis_sva.sv, bound to the block. Planned. Also a formal property - waiting for JasperGold.

NAME: a_set_beats_clear
details: An event in the cycle of its own clear leaves the bit set, in IRQSTAT and in STATUS.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/spi_slave/garuda_spis_sva.sv, bound to the block. Planned. Also a formal property - waiting for JasperGold.

NAME: cg_spis_irq.x_src_en_clear
details: Each source with its enable 0 and 1; cleared in the cycle of a new event.
implementation_note: Covergroup in the UVM environment. Planned.

NAME: F23 DMA request while a byte is waiting
details: With DMACTL bit 0 set. The request drops for at least one pclk after each acknowledge; beats are word sized with the byte in bits 7:0. Spec [N-7.6].
implementation_note: Method: sim (DMA request agent) + formal. Today: tb_spis

NAME: a_dma_drop
details: dma_req_o is 0 in the pclk after dma_ack_i.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/spi_slave/garuda_spis_sva.sv, bound to the block. Planned. Also a formal property - waiting for JasperGold.

NAME: dma_req_checker
details: One beat per assertion, no stuck request.
implementation_note: tb/common/dma_req_checker.sv.

NAME: G With the rest of the chip
details: Checked at chip level and by connectivity checks.

NAME: F24 Window 0 CLIC ID 14 DMA channel 4 and the pads
details: Wired at the chip top by INT-1 and INT-3.
implementation_note: Method: sim at chip level + connectivity. Today: sw/chip/t_chip_periph.c, t_chip_integ.c

NAME: t_chip_periph
details: SPI slave part - a frame from the companion model at the pads, read from C.
implementation_note: sw/chip/t_chip_periph.c, passing.

NAME: conn_spis
details: Bound assertions at the chip top for the interrupt, request, acknowledge and the four pads.
implementation_note: Planned.

NAME: F25 A packet received by DMA into memory
details: The intended use - one interrupt per packet, bytes moved by channel 4.
implementation_note: Method: sim at chip level (scenario). Today: no check.

NAME: t_chip_spis_dma
details: A 64-byte frame from the companion model into DSRAM by DMA.
implementation_note: sw/chip. Planned.

NAME: H Clock and reset
details: Spec 7.1, section 9.

NAME: F26 No new asynchronous clock domain
details: SCLK, MOSI and chip select are synchronised and oversampled on pclk; no flop is clocked by SCLK. Requirement R-4, spec [N-7.1].
implementation_note: Method: static (clock-domain check). Today: HAL lint on the block - 0 errors

NAME: hal_cdc
details: Three synchronised inputs and no second clock.
implementation_note: flow/2_static. To run on this block.
